title: Al Basma
description:
Al Basma is a luxury car showroom in Sharjah’s Souq Al Haraj, one of the region’s busiest automotive marketplaces.

Automotive retail branding often relies on chrome, aggressive type and visual noise. Our goal was the opposite: an identity that gets attention through restraint. It needed to work at every scale, from a business card to a full-height digital totem, and feel as at home on a showroom wall as on a website.

The wordmark pairs a bold, geometric symbol with clean, wide-set capitals. The symbol is a solid oval holding a single curved form. [It references the meaning of “Basma,” a smile or a signature imprint, and reads like an eye looking forward.] Its simple shape makes it recognisable at small sizes and strong on large signage.

The typography is set in wide, even capitals to give the name space. Small details in the letterforms give it a custom character without losing legibility.
